title: Concrete finite Yoneda extensions and their operations
statement: In a category with zero morphisms, a degree-$i$ extension of $U$ by $V$ is a composable sequence of $i+1$ arrows, exact at its middle objects, with monic first arrow and epic last arrow, and isomorphisms identifying the first and last objects with $V$ and $U$. Endpoint maps are conjugated by these isomorphisms. Classes are the quotient by the equivalence relation generated by maps fixing both endpoints. In an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], a degree-one extension is split if its short complex has a splitting. Splice data identify the first middle object and subsequent tail with a specified short complex and smaller-degree extension, with the three commuting equations. Baer-sum data specify termwise products, diagonal pullback at $U$, addition pushout at $V$, and isomorphisms at unchanged middle objects. These are precisely the existing YonedaExtension definitions, moved unchanged to an independent module.
